name: Morata de Jiloca (Spain)
description: Blue field with two white horizontal stripes, charged towards the hoist with the crowned arms of Morata de Jiloca (a castle on blue above waves and the bars of Aragon).
history: By decree 17/1994 of 26 January the Diputación General de Aragón authorised the town council of Morata de Jiloca, in the province of Zaragoza, to adopt its municipal arms and flag; the arms of the town are placed at a third of the length from the hoist, their height including the crown being half the width of the flag.
